title: The Delivery Switchboard
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the delivery switchboard for its fictional reader task. A compact settings console places delivery choices beside a tall confirmation clock and separates urgent-message policy beneath the form. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Poppins, #442F89 and #E6D5FF. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
